# e2b_teams (Data Source)

Lists E2B teams visible to the configured access token. E2B exposes teams as read-only identity context in the public API and does not expose team creation through this API. This route requires `access_token` provider configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "e2b_teams" "available" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `teams` (Attributes List) E2B teams. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--teams))

<a id="nestedatt--teams"></a>
### Nested Schema for `teams`

Read-Only:

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Team API key returned by E2B's team listing route.
- `id` (String) Team ID.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default team.
- `name` (String) Team name.
